scoring_rule: PASS / LIMITATION / FAIL per dimension; FAIL never hidden inside averages

temporal_consistency.rationale: 75% positive windows, 1 sign flip, survives best-window removal; 2022 negative; window-level p≈0.21 not significant

regime_consistency.rationale: Effect absent/negative in 2022 bear + high-vol regime; per-session regime stratification unavailable (window-level only)

universe_consistency.rationale: Positive across ENV-050, ENV-100, TOP25, BOT25 (+0.0228..+0.0349); ENV-100 n=4 windows

model_family_consistency.rationale: Effect does not replicate in nonlinear families (RF/XGB negative mean IC historically); only linear models carry it

statistical_support.rationale: Window-level t-test p≈0.20-0.22; 95% CI includes zero; fails Holm correction; n=8 windows limits power but evidence remains insignificant

economic_materiality.rationale: Mean sequential IC ≈0.02-0.03 (below 0.05 academic ref); economic usefulness remains untested at the portfolio-construction layer

perturbation_stability.rationale: Cost/slippage graceful; LOO benign; BUT feature-noise cliff (CAND-04 sign-flips at 5% noise), parameter sweep NaN gaps, delay degrades IC

reproducibility.rationale: Historical phases replicated (12.9B B) but 13A-vs-13B independent implementations diverge on identical window (ratio 3.1x) due to purge-boundary defect in 13B; conservative 13A basis adopted
